name: CreateLoadBalancer
label: Create AWS ELB Load Balancer
description: Creates an Application or Network Load Balancer in AWS Elastic Load Balancing (ALB/NLB).

fields.name: AWSServiceVaultId
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: Select the AWS credential to use for authentication (AWSServiceVaultId).

fields.name: IpAddressType
fields.label: IP Address Type
fields.description: The IP address type of the load balancer.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The name of the load balancer.

fields.name: Schema
fields.label: Schema
fields.description: Specifies whether the load balancer is internal or internet-facing.

fields.name: Type
fields.label: Type
fields.description: The type of load balancer: Application or Network.

fields.name: SubnetIds
fields.label: Subnet ID Names or IDs
fields.description: List of subnet IDs where the load balancer will be deployed.

fields.name: AdditionalFields
fields.label: Additional Fields
fields.description: Optional tags to attach to the load balancer (key-value pairs).

fields.name: Region
fields.label: AWS Region
fields.description: The AWS region where the load balancer is located (e.g., us-east-1). Default: us-east-1.

fields.name: LoadBalancerArn
fields.label: Load Balancer ARN
fields.description: The ARN of the created load balancer.

fields.name: DnsName
fields.label: DNS Name
fields.description: The DNS name of the created load balancer.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from AWS ELB.
